dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Tengu of the Kujou Clan, hear me! You'll pay for taking away my Vision! Don't you forget about our duel!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I'll be waiting for you! Think long and hard about whom you've offended each time you come through this door!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Reply
dialogues.text: Dear guest, although I don't know what Madam Kujou Sara has done to you, you are always welcome here to relax.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Haha, of course! This is Mr. Okazaki's place after all!"
